title: What Can $11 Million Buy? — $34 : $1
description: Open Graph / link-preview card for the campaign-finance ledger. A giant $34 : $1 ratio — $34 spent opposing Graham Platner for every $1 supporting him — above a proportional bar that is nearly all red with a thin green sliver.
alt_text: Dark graphic titled “What Can $11 Million Buy?” A large ratio reads $34 to $1 — $34 spent opposing, $1 spent supporting. A bar below is nearly all red with a thin green sliver. Text: $11,077,173 opposing, $323,426 supporting, every FEC filing linked.
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
usage_note: Data visualization compiled from public FEC filings and cited press reporting. Figures: $11,077,173 spent opposing Graham Platner vs. $323,426 supporting (FEC Schedule E, deduplicated, Oct 2025 – Jul 8, 2026).
